items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I'd try to say something nice... I used to say, 'Mr. Duke'-- Ellington, you know. I'd say, 'You know, my partner is a big fan of yours.'

ctx.x: of themselves, you know. They had forgotten that they was poor. Of course, they had gotten back some of their returns and their, you know, their fortunes or whatever their savings were, you know, and they was back into their own speculation, see.

But that was the most thrilling thing, see. I mean, of course, now my partner, Chuckles -- like he had to learn these -- he was playing this musical instrument and I think Mr. Ellington -- he was kind of proud of that -- of course, the vibraphone was something like the piano, in a way, you know. And he could (unintelligible) scat operatic, you see. Operatic singing, but he was doing it in scat. And he was very funny -- it was comical. They had him doing this jazz so you -- it just got to be loved -- this fellow,…
to be impressive to him, you know. I guess he was tickled about it, you know. It was a great experience, you see, and he always inspired everyone that I know, especially that show, you see.
